messages:
Eli Warner: kicking off SDK py/ts staggered publish for 1.4.2 during the quiet window. starting canary first.
release-bot: [publish] job_id=190001 status=running step=py-upload
Priya Nair: heads up, CI job hit a token refresh error on the npm publish step: E401 token expired. twine/python looks OK for now.
Jun Park: saw the same on my run locally earlier 1: token refresh endpoint returned 502 intermittently. Could be registry side flakiness.
deploy-bot: [publish] job_id=190001 status=failed step=ts-upload reason=401 Token expired
Eli Warner: hold on promoting anything. Options: (A) request Ops ephemeral token and finish canary then promote; (B) yank the npm `latest` tag for safety and republish later. Thoughts?
Priya Nair: prefer ephemeral token to finish the canary so we don't orphan a partial release. If Ops can't provide one quickly, we yank. Also prepare a short changelog patch in case we need to republish as 1.4.3.
OpsTeam: we can issue an ephemeral publish token for 30m. pushing to the CI secrets now.
deploy-bot: [publish] job_id=190005 status=running step=ts-upload using-ephemeral-token
Priya Nair: npm publish succeeded to `next`. twine upload already succeeded earlier. Running smoke installs in staging now.
Jun Park: smoke install OK for both pip and npm. running quick integration test suite.
Eli Warner: leave 1.4.1 pinned as rollback anchor for 45m. Do not flip `latest` until smoke tests pass 15m.
release-bot: [monitor] cohort=canary_20 status=running
Jun Park: integration tests pass at 12m. no regressions.
Eli Warner: promote to `latest` now with `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.2 latest`. Keep 1.4.1 pinned as discussed.
deploy-bot: [release] action=promote job_id=190010 status=success -> @redwood/sdk@1.4.2 set to latest
Priya Nair: changelog PR created and includes note: "Publishing interruption resolved with ephemeral creds; monitor for 1h; rollback instructions included."
OpsTeam: ephemeral token rotated out; CI token refresh endpoint will be looked at in follow-up.
Eli Warner: final summary: republished under ephemeral token, promoted to latest, rollback plan anchored to 1.4.1, changelog updated. Filing follow-up issue for token refresh reliability and pre-publish healthcheck. Closing thread.
